UPDATE persistence_schema_compatibility
        SET schema_version = 10,
            min_reader_app_version = '0.3.1',
            min_writer_app_version = '0.3.1',
            updated_by_migration = 10,
            updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE singleton_key = 1
